title: Credits
introduction: SNEStorage brings together community work and open-source tools. Meet the creator and the people whose projects help make the site possible.

creator.name: anonimzwx
creator.role: Creator, developer, and maintainer of SNEStorage

entries.title: Floating IPS (Flips)
entries.description: Creator of Floating IPS, the IPS/BPS patching tool used as a reference for SNEStorage's patching feature. The browser tool uses an independent JavaScript implementation of the patch formats.

entries.title: SMW Central SPC Player
entries.description: The SPC audio backend used for resource previews and the local SPC playlist is adapted from SMW Central's player. SNEStorage adds its own interface, browser library, and playback controls.

entries.title: snes_spc & BRR decoding
entries.by: Shay Green (blargg), with resampling contributions by Liam Wilson
entries.description: The SNES sound emulator beneath the SPC player. SNEStorage's BRR sample decoder also adapts the DSP decoding logic distributed with the upstream player.

entries.title: BPS patch format
entries.description: Author of the public-domain BPS specification used by the browser patcher to interpret patches and verify checksums.

entries.title: Marked
entries.description: Markdown parsing for news, resource descriptions, and comments.

entries.title: DOMPurify
entries.description: HTML sanitization for the site's Markdown renderer.

entries.title: Cropper.js
entries.description: The image cropping component used by the avatar editor.

entries.title: Bootstrap
entries.description: Interface foundations, including the mobile navigation drawer.
